gloss: to go back; to trace back

definitions.gloss: to go upstream; to go against the current
definitions.explanation: To travel in the opposite direction of a river's flow.

definitions.gloss: to trace back; to go back in time
definitions.explanation: To examine or consider events from the past; to date back to an earlier time.

examples.japanese: {歴史|れきし}を{遡|さかのぼ}って{調|しら}べる。
examples.english: To research by tracing back through history.

examples.japanese: この{問題|もんだい}は{10年前|じゅうねんまえ}に{遡|さかのぼ}る。
examples.english: This problem dates back to 10 years ago.

examples.japanese: {鮭|さけ}は{川|かわ}を{遡|さかのぼ}って{卵|たまご}を{産|う}む。
examples.english: Salmon go upstream to lay their eggs.

examples.japanese: {記憶|きおく}を{遡|さかのぼ}って、あの{日|ひ}のことを{思|おも}い{出|だ}そうとした。
examples.english: I tried to trace back through my memories to recall what happened that day.

examples.japanese: ボートで{流|なが}れに{逆|さか}らって{川|かわ}を{遡|さかのぼ}った。
examples.english: I went upstream by boat against the current.

examples.japanese: この{伝統|でんとう}は{江戸|えど}{時代|じだい}まで{遡|さかのぼ}ることができる。
examples.english: This tradition can be traced back to the Edo period.

examples.japanese: {源流|げんりゅう}を{目指|めざ}して{何時間|なんじかん}も{山道|やまみち}を{遡|さかのぼ}り{続|つづ}けた。
examples.english: I kept going upstream along the mountain path for hours, aiming for the river's source.

examples.japanese: {家系|かけい}を{遡|さかのぼ}ると、{祖先|そせん}は{九州|きゅうしゅう}から{来|き}たらしい。
examples.english: Tracing back my family lineage, it seems my ancestors came from Kyushu.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). Pattern: Xを{遡|さかのぼ}る (to go back along X).

WRITING: Can also be written as {溯|さかのぼ}る (older kanji variant).

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{川|かわ}を{遡|さかのぼ}る (to go upstream)
・{時間|じかん}を{遡|さかのぼ}る (to go back in time)
・{過去|かこ}に{遡|さかのぼ}る (to trace back to the past)
・{記憶|きおく}を{遡|さかのぼ}る (to go back through memories)

CONTRAST:
・{下|くだ}る (to go downstream, descend)
